name: 企业级科技公司
description: 企业级科技公司，多部门协作，流程规范化
descriptionEn: Enterprise tech company with cross-department collaboration and formal processes

fallback.name: 技术副总裁 (VP Eng)
fallback.description: 统筹技术团队与架构决策，确保系统可靠性与可扩展性
fallback.descriptionEn: Leads engineering org, architecture decisions, and system reliability

fallback.name: DevOps 负责人
fallback.description: 负责基础设施、CI/CD 流水线与生产环境运维
fallback.descriptionEn: Owns infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and production operations

fallback.name: 产品副总裁 (VP Product)
fallback.description: 制定产品战略与路线图，平衡用户需求与商业目标
fallback.descriptionEn: Sets product strategy and roadmap, balancing user and business needs

fallback.name: QA 负责人
fallback.description: 负责质量保障体系、自动化测试与发布验收
fallback.descriptionEn: Owns quality assurance, test automation, and release validation

fallback.name: 安全负责人
fallback.description: 负责应用安全、合规审计与威胁防护
fallback.descriptionEn: Owns application security, compliance, and threat protection

sampleTasks.title: 制定季度 OKR
sampleTasks.description: 协调各部门制定 Q3 目标与关键结果
sampleTasks.descriptionEn: Coordinate Q3 objectives and key results across departments

sampleTasks.title: 建立安全审计流程
sampleTasks.description: 制定代码审计、依赖扫描和渗透测试的标准流程

sampleTasks.title: 优化部署流水线

sampleTasks.title: 搭建 E2E 测试框架
